JSZip 3.10.1
  License: MIT
  License text: LICENSE-jszip.txt
  Source: https://github.com/Stuk/jszip

@ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.11.6 and @ffmpeg/core 0.11.0
  Package license: MIT
  License text: LICENSE-ffmpeg-wasm.txt
  The core includes FFmpeg 5.1.2, distributed under LGPL-2.1-or-later.
  License text: LICENSE-ffmpeg-lgpl.txt
  Source: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm

These dependencies are version-pinned distribution files. The only local
change is the @ffmpeg/ffmpeg wrapper default corePath, pinned to the bundled
vendor/ffmpeg-core.js instead of its upstream CDN URL. No codec binaries were
modified. Corresponding license texts are provided beside the runtime assets.
